What it could say

  • Fourteen years, fifteen reviews

    You have 15 Google reviews. The landscapers in Maps’ top five have up to 165. Reviews are one of the three things Maps ranks on.

  • Not in Maps’ top 20 for “landscaping”

    Searched from central Mesa, your home town. Companies with a fraction of your history rank above you.

  • Your email is a Gmail address

    craje.landscaping@gmail.com works, but an address at crajelandscaping.com looks more established on quotes and HOA bids.

  • The family story is buried

    “Family owned, locally operated for 14 years” is a small line. The reviews thank Aaron and family by name; that’s the headline.

  • Reviews that sit still

    Your newest reviews are months apart. A steady trickle tells Google you’re busy.

  • A small social following

    About 110 Facebook followers. Before-and-after yard photos are made for social.

Website article

After a dust storm: a yard clean-up checklist 1. Clear branches first; they hide damage to sprinklers and drip lines. 2. Check trees for cracked or hanging limbs before the next wind. 3. Rinse plants: dust blocks sunlight and stresses them in the heat. 4. Test the irrigation. Debris clogs emitters. Need a crew fast? Call CRAJE at (480) 238-1390.
